nozzle.tank_l_reason: Water carried on the robot. A Spot-class quadruped carries about 14 kg of payload; 12 L of water plus the pump and nozzle fits it. The robot cannot refill inside the building.
nozzle.flow_lps_reason: Flow from a small battery pump. Firefighting hand lines run 2 to 8 L/s; a robot-mounted pump on this payload delivers about 1 L/s, so a full tank lasts 12 s.
nozzle.range_m_reason: Throw of a 1 L/s straight-to-narrow-fog stream at the pressure such a pump gives; water beyond this does not reach the fire as a stream.
nozzle.half_angle_deg_reason: Half-angle of a narrow fog pattern, wide enough to cover a 2 m wide fire 5 m away, narrow enough to keep the range.
nozzle.max_spray_s_reason: Longest single spray an agent may order, so one order cannot empty the tank; it can order again after the robot looks again.
nozzle.aim_tolerance_deg_reason: An agent may spray only toward a hot spot its cited thermal scan found within this bearing of the requested direction (half the thermal camera's 50 degree field is 25 degrees; 15 keeps the stream on the measured fire).

rescue.reach_m_reason: A person may be gripped when the nearest point of their body is within this distance ahead of the robot (the arm reaches 1.2 m; a lying person's near edge sits a little beyond).
rescue.grip_s_reason: Time to fit the drag strap and lift the shoulders onto the rescue sled with the arm.
rescue.tow_offset_m_reason: The sled rides this far behind the robot body on its strap.
rescue.carry_speed_mps_reason: Walking speed while dragging an adult on a low-friction rescue sled. Assumed for a Spot-class robot pulling roughly 150 to 200 N (sled friction on a smooth floor); slow enough to keep the strap and sled stable.
rescue.grip_cone_deg_reason: A person may be gripped only within this angle of the robot's heading; the same 60 deg cone RobotActions.BeginExtract applies to the arm's contact check.
